messages.subject: Functionalities request:
parts:
Would be cool if the any widget had an "edit" mode, which after made on, allows a user (most commonly admin or a superuser) to edit with / right / click with / without ctrl / alt:

- choices if it comes to radio and checkboxes
- options if it comes to selectize
- labels and names of of the widgets and "aliases / ids" (something like a secondary ID, or aliases)

After that, the user (most commonly admin / superuser) could save such a widget in UI file, if not directly,than by includes / source etc

This would streamline the heck out of our jobs!

Also, another really cool thing would be if the widget could be moved out and in into colums etc (WYSIWYG) kind a thing.
Best
